messages.subject: New resource-Bioacoustics stack exchange
parts:
Hi Seewave group,
          I just wanted to let you know that my team at the Southwest Fisheries science center started a Stack Exchange group for acoustic folks. We are hoping that it will be another resource for people to come together and ask questions. Stack Exchange is an easily searchable platform and so far we have almost 1500 users. Feel free to check it out 

https://bioacoustics.stackexchange.com/
